issue.title: RN: Settings flashes when a 3-way choice is saved
issue.body:
Part of #2978. Owner on-device finding, 2026-10-20, on the iPad and the Galaxy:

> "android & ios - when I click the 3-way settings toggles (ex Parent center every time, per session, never) the purple highlight correctly animates to the new selection, but I see a very tiny screen re-fresh / flash"

## Where

Located by reading the code; this is an unverified hypothesis.

* `experiments/native-architecture/src/settings/parentSaves.ts`, `persistParent`: publishes `status: 'saving'` before the write, then `ready`.
* While saving, every control is disabled:
  * `canEditParent()` in `settings/soundSettings.ts` is false, which disables every Parent Center option (`RsdParentCenterSection.tsx`).
  * `RsdSettingsDialog.tsx` sets `busy = settings.status !== 'ready'` across all of Settings.
* `RsdSegmentedPicker.tsx` applies `styles.disabled` (opacity 0.65) to disabled options.

## Likely cause

Each save dims all of Settings for the length of the write and then restores it. That dim-and-restore is the flash; it is not a remount.

## Done when

Changing a 3-way control on either device shows only the highlight's move. Shipping applies the choice at once and never dims the sheet for a save.
issue.display_title: RN: Settings flashes when a 3-way choice is saved

comments.body: Fixed by #3082, merged as e87ca5383fec9e638d3783c5984d7aa28df67b00. A Parent Center or AI Art save no longer dims Settings for its write. Taps during the write still do nothing, and the previous protection holds until the write lands. Mounted tests cover the options and the quick controls; each fails with the old dim.
